question: Why might a light sweater use a salt-free deodorant?
answer: Aluminum salts work by plugging sweat pores. If you sweat little, there is almost nothing to plug, so their action is wasted. The salts are not harmful; they are simply pointless when there is little sweat.
move: Salt-free is fine when there is little sweat to stop.
